items.title: Tank Bigsby: Placed on IR
items.body_text: The Eagles placed Bigsby (abdomen) on injured reserve Tuesday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Viewed as 'unlikely' for Week 5
items.body_text: Jackson appears "unlikely" to play Sunday against the Falcons due to a "rarer type of ankle sprain" that could put him at risk of missing multiple games, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Mixon: Not joining Seattle after all
items.body_text: The Seahawks opted not to sign Mixon (foot) after he underwent a physical for the team Tuesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Could miss multiple games
items.body_text: Jackson (ankle) is not dealing with a long-term injury, but he has "only an outside chance to play" in Week 5 and "could end up missing multiple games," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Pitts: Uptick in production during big win
items.body_text: Pitts secured all three targets for 47 yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
